svg.title: Pilot of the Indus Fleet / RARE

g.data-name: RARE / silver-blue, faceted gems, chamfer brackets
Rarity / silver-blue, faceted gems, chamfer brackets
Portrait inlay / rank and figure emblems

text.tspan: A fleet pilot weighs currents, shoals, and the shape of the
coast before setting a course. Seasoned judgment turns
uncertain water into a passage others can follow,
protecting the expedition when confidence alone would fail.
